review_method: All 76 numbered frames inspected on three sequential contact sheets; overlap region inspected frame by frame.

ball.visual_result: The prompted point remains on the fluorescent ball until exit, remains on the ball during the racket overlap, and produces no post-exit false point.

racket.visual_result: Visible points remain attached to physical racket regions; no point transfers to the hand, body, court, or ball. Individual points become invisible as the corresponding racket region exits frame.

ball.visual_result: The mask follows the ball but is systematically broader than the visible ball, remains one frame after verified exit, and misses the pre-registered center-error gate.

racket.visual_result: The mask remains on the physical racket for 76/76 frames, follows the head and handle through the fast overlap, shows no transfer, and clips honestly when the racket leaves frame.
